summary: The 8-K reports that Super Micro Computer, Inc. entered into a distribution agreement with J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, and Citigroup to sell up to $1.25B of common stock through an at-the-market (ATM) program. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices via ordinary brokers' transactions, market maker trades, or privately negotiated deals, with agents earning up to 1.0% commission. The company is not obligated to sell any shares and may terminate at any time. This routine equity shelf takedown is used for general corporate purposes, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
